description: Preview inputs only. Geometry and defaults remain furnishings.py authority; material bindings are illustrative semantic materials.

placement.service_screen: Architectural assembly: explicit front/rear and left/right extents; serving transom above 2.43 m. Align return with room joinery.
placement.counter_returns: Assembly behind a counter; at is the front of the return, not its footprint centre.
placement.service_counter: Floor assembly with a separate writing station; keep the public side reachable.
placement.framed_picture: Back-wall mounting; at includes centre height. Bind an artwork material with its own image; preview uses plain paper.
placement.potted_plant: Floor or support surface. Bind foliage_mat; preview uses the semantic foliage colour without its texture.
placement.shelf: Back-wall mounting at y and z; depth is derived from room.back_x.
placement.lantern: Back-wall mounting with a separate point light; catalogue flat preview does not show its illumination.
placement.azulejo_dado: Wall treatment; uses room.back_x, half_width and openings. Fixture includes a doorway to demonstrate the interruption.
placement.window_dressing: Back-wall opening coordinates y0/y1/z0/z1; pair with the same opening used by the shell.
placement.stair: Descending stair; geometry extends below Z=0. Review the threshold and character-floor projection in native views.
placement.tool_rail: Back-wall mounting at y and z.
placement.water_stand: Customer-reachable drinking water. Keep the stand outside the exit approach and review its silhouette with the player present.
placement.door_frame: Around a door opening on the back wall (lo/hi along Y) or an end wall (wall=-y/+y, lo/hi along X); pass the same span and height as the opening.
